description: Reports the Mate setup of the workspace: status interview, planning, planned, building, completed or failed, the plan generation state with its error, the build phases (knowledgeBase, dataModel, views, records, dashboard) with status and error, the current phase, the Knowledge Base pages planned and written, and finishedAt. Only reads: a setup that the workspace creation started from a description moves from planned to building on the server by itself as soon as its plan is ready, whether or not anyone reads the status; a setup started in the app waits for the owner to confirm the plan there. status null means no setup ran; available false carries the reason, such as configured for a workspace that already has lists.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: get_workspace_setup_status
title: Get workspace setup status
